message: docs(order): show how to put style imports first

operations.anchor:
> These warnings are not fixable with `--fix` since unassigned imports might be used for their [side-effects][31],
> and changing the order of such imports cannot be done safely.
operations.text:
> [!TIP]
>
> If side-effect style imports should appear before other imports, combine `warnOnUnassignedImports` with a `pathGroups` entry. For example:
>
> ```jsonc
> {
>   "import/order": ["error", {
>     "newlines-between": "never",
>     "warnOnUnassignedImports": true,
>     "pathGroups": [{
>       "pattern": "**/*.{css,scss}",
>       "group": "builtin",
>       "position": "before"
>     }]
>   }]
> }
> ```
